query: UPDATE analysis_runs r SET status = 'failed', code = CASE WHEN j.last_error_code ~ '^CS-[A-Z]+-[0-9]{4}$' THEN j.last_error_code ELSE 'CS-WRK-0015' END, finished_at = $4 FROM jobs j WHERE r.account_id = $1 AND j.account_id = $1 AND j.idempotency_key = r.job_key AND r.status IN ('queued', 'running') AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR r.document_id = $2) AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR j.id = $3) AND (j.status = 'dead' OR (j.status = 'running' AND j.locked_until < $4 AND j.attempts >= j.max_attempts))
